controls.evidence_volume: irrelevant valid evidence changes no P2 or P3 decision
controls.outcome_fixed_authority: task input, producer output, semantic result, actual outcome, and action outcome remain fixed while only authority-consuming decisions and conformance may change
controls.verifier_failure: false accept, false reject, disagreement, error, and unknown are representable
controls.record_only: audit resolution may improve while consequential action benefit is not applicable

failure_condition: any control violation rejects meta qualification
